original.target_description: Experiment 2: between-participant association of accepting idiographically defined unfair offers with right VLPFC activation during accepted relative to rejected unfair offers, peak [50, 24, 8]; Figure 4d.

p.location: Experiment 2, fMRI Results: Accepting Unfair Offers, printed p. 344 (PDF p. 6), right column; Figure 4d
p.quote: who accepted a higher proportion of idiographically defined ... unfair offers showed a greater increase in activity in right ... VLPFC (x 5 50, y 5 24, z 5 8), t(11) 5 3.68, prep > .99, d 5 ... 2.22, and a greater decrease in activity in the anterior insula on

notes: Only unfinished field pval_value_o was assessed. All other value fields are unassigned placeholders. Source title and Experiment 2 verified. The target association prints t(11) = 3.68, d = 2.22 and p_rep > .99; Figure 4d prints r = .76. p_rep is a replication probability, not a conventional p value, so it is not entered into p.value or converted. The p < .01 on printed p. 343 is a liberal threshold for absence of reward-region activity, not this target test. The p = .005/.001 values on p. 342 are analysis thresholds, not target-test p values. The nearby VLPFC accepted-unfair versus resting-baseline result (t = 5.39, d = 3.25) is a different test. No N calculation performed. PDF pages 5–6 rendered and visually inspected.
